'''AccuTronics''' was a company that manufactured various models of worker [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and droid parts prior to and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

A former subsidiary of [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]], AccuTronics pioneered the use of droids for family-oriented purposes<ref name="J13" /> and specialized in this sector of the market.<ref name="G3" /> AccuTronics' success in this endeavour allowed them to move out of the shadow of their former parent company and establish themselves as a leader in their field.<ref name="EGTD" /> AccuTronics had several offices and dealerships in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and its headquarters were based on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]],<ref name="G3" /> where its main offices were located in the capital of [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]].<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The [[MK 8001 Attendant Droid|MK 8001]] was its top-selling product.<ref name="J13" />
